steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Compare. Each term is matched to the agreed position. A term that differs is flagged.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 2 terms differ from the agreed position

findings.title: Liability term differs from the agreed position
findings.fix: Reject the term or agree the change

findings.title: Governing law differs from the agreed position
Exclusivity binds the organisation with no agreed position

outcome.notChecked: Whether a term is enforceable in the jurisdiction, and the legal effect of any clause, which counsel decides.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (2 high, 1 medium).
[high] term-liability.md:12  Liability term differs from the agreed position.
       Fix: Reject the term or agree the change.
[high] term-governing-law.md:19  Governing law differs from the agreed position.
       Fix: Restore the agreed governing law.
[medium] term-exclusivity.md:26  Exclusivity binds the organisation with no agreed position.
       Fix: Take the exclusivity to counsel.
Not checked: Whether a term is enforceable in the jurisdiction, and the legal effect of any clause, which counsel decides.
pros: Checks a term that differs, a term missing from the sheet, a term with no agreed position to compare against, and a term that binds the organisation in a way the agreed position did not allow.
cons: Not checked: Whether a term is enforceable in the jurisdiction, and the legal effect of any clause, which counsel decides.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-neg-term-sheet-review skill on the records for this review.
